name: Configures animation loop tags in TagManagerModal and imports a spritesheet via the interactive auto-slicer
description: Verify opening the dedicated TagManagerModal from the timeline ribbon, adding and reordering loop clips, then launching the ImportModal, selecting Sprite Sheet Slicer mode with 16x16 grid cells, inspecting neon cutlines, and batch-importing sliced animation frames.

planSteps.description: Verify the studio workspace and bottom animation timeline are rendered
Click the Manage Tags button in the bottom timeline (data-testid manage-tags-button)
Verify the Animation Tags & Clips modal opens displaying tag lists and frame range selectors
Type 'Walk Cycle' into the new tag name input
Verify the new tag 'Walk Cycle' appears in the animation tags list
Click the Done button to close the modal
Verify the tagged clip ribbon appears on the animation timeline
